traditional: No classical doctrine: Neptune is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Identity meets imagination and idealism. Heightened sensitivity, imagination, and a pull toward the ideal. Psychologically the opposition is inner tension to integrate: Susceptibility to illusion and escapism, and to the rescuer/rescued dynamic. The self can get foggy. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

cyclic.meaning: Selfhood and imagination reach full awareness and face each other: culmination, objectivity, fulfillment or confrontation.

business: Friction in this area. Creative or service-oriented directions; guard against self-deception and being played.
shadow: Egotism and needing to be the center collides with illusion and escapism; forcing or splitting it instead of working it through.
arcApplying: A confrontation builds; the other side comes fully into view.
arcSeparating: The standoff resolves into balance or a split.
